en: The postcard features a historical black-and-white photograph of a busy town square with ornate, multi-story European buildings bordering an open space filled with trees, market stalls, and crowds of people. The caption reads 'Sundsvall. Torget.' and additional handwritten text is present. The reverse side includes address lines in Swedish, a Swedish 5 öre stamp, and a Swedish postmark from 1902.
